villa_snapshot: Property snapshot

Set amidst two acres of verdant tropical landscape, this exquisite estate features a remarkable glass retreat- a sanctuary of refined simplicity and natural beauty. This boho tent offers a queen-sized wooden poster bed framed by lush indoor plants and expansive sliding glass doors dressed with sheer curtains, inviting the serene forest into the space. Carefully curated with artisanal driftwood sculptures, natural fiber lighting, and warm wooden furnishings, the retreat seamlessly balances rustic charm with modern comforts including air conditioning, a dedicated workstation, and boho-charm Outside, the Nyaman Patio provides a private oasis, where handcrafted wooden seating and softly glowing woven lanterns create an inviting atmosphere embraced by dense greenery and bamboo fencing.

Complementing this tranquil haven, the ensuite Lembah Bath exudes understated luxury- featuring a grey-stone bathtub, warm wooden accents, organic toiletries, and ambient skylight illumination, offering a serene space for rejuvenation.

Guests have access to expansive shared spaces that beautifully marry Moroccan and Balinese influences. The centerpiece is a stunning Moroccan-inspired pool complex, featuring a pristine 4-foot main pool, adjoining jacuzzi and all set on elegant white concrete decks surrounded by graceful palms and unique sculptural art. Plush wooden loungers and shaded umbrellas invite leisurely relaxation in this lush setting.
The Taman Sari Garden provides a thoughtfully designed retreat, with elegantly built-in benches, bamboo-lined walkways, swings, and curated greenery, perfect for moments of peaceful reflection.

Multiple shared patios embrace Bali’s effortless charm, featuring stylish wicker furnishings, cosy swings, bamboo daybeds with flowing curtains, and the sophisticated Bar Atara. This refined bar space emanates a soft, radiant ambience, accentuated by delicate teardrop lanterns. Nearby, the Ombak Boho Lounge (Ombak meaning “waves”) invites guests to unwind amid tropical rhythms, with wicker seating, intricate string décor, and an elevated DJ platform that sets the tone for elegant, music-filled evenings.
For active guests, the Arena Santai Pickleball Court offers a versatile sports experience, accommodating tennis, badminton, ping-pong, and basketball, all framed by lush greenery and mature trees.

As twilight deepens, the estate’s Ashāra Pits provide an intimate setting for evening gatherings. These sunken firepit areas featuring smooth stone seating and subtle ambient lighting offer a warm and inviting ambience for quiet conversations beneath the stars.

To enhance your stay, a dedicated 5-star hospitality team is always at your service, offering attentive care and warm smiles that embody the spirit of "Atithi Devo Bhava." From a personal butler and chef-on-call to a well-stocked fridge and a premium welcome basket, every detail is meticulously curated to ensure that guests feel pampered, valued, and truly at home.
